description: Dynamic attributes processing of a remaining body fails on blocks already taken
notes: The spec says partial processing leaves out every block of a type the schema requests, so the remaining body has only the attribute c, and dynamic attributes processing gives c. hashicorp/hcl hides taken blocks from further schema processing, but its dynamic attributes processing checks for any block in the original body ((*Body).JustAttributes in hclsyntax/structure.go), so it reports the block b.
